//dependencies: The bottom of the layering (docs/architecture.md): nothing here can reach a disk, a server or a browser. A workspace sibling appearing here would be a layering violation, and `bun install` is what would report it. fastest-levenshtein is the did-you-mean distance — a focused, dependency-free library rather than eighteen lines of textbook matrix arithmetic we would then own.
